answer: Creating N fake identities costs N times the minimum bond, so mass sybil creation becomes capital-expensive. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted bonding: each agent locks a bond at the wharf registry, and voting weight scales with bonded value minus slashing history. Any fable of free identities collapses once the glacier of accumulated stake freezes out low-cost attackers, since legitimate peers simply out-bond them. From once0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
